description: Get total sales amount per product category for the last 30 days
pyspark_code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

df = spark.table("sales.transactions")

result = (
    df
    .filter(F.col("transaction_date") >= F.date_sub(F.current_date(), 30))
    .groupBy("product_category")
    .agg(F.sum("amount").alias("total_sales"))
    .orderBy(F.col("total_sales").desc())
)

result.show()

description: Join customers with orders and find customers who have placed more than 5 orders in the last quarter
pyspark_code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

customers = spark.table("crm.customers")
orders = spark.table("sales.orders")

result = (
    customers
    .join(orders, customers["customer_id"] == orders["customer_id"], "inner")
    .filter(F.col("order_date") >= F.date_sub(F.current_date(), 90))
    .groupBy(
        customers["customer_id"],
        customers["customer_name"],
        customers["email"]
    )
    .agg(F.count("order_id").alias("order_count"))
    .filter(F.col("order_count") > 5)
    .orderBy(F.col("order_count").desc())
)

result.show()

description: Calculate the running total of revenue per region, ordered by date
pyspark_code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

df = spark.table("finance.revenue")

window_spec = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("report_date").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

result = (
    df
    .withColumn("running_total", F.sum("revenue_amount").over(window_spec))
    .orderBy("region", "report_date")
)

result.show()

description: Find the top 3 products by sales in each category using a window function
pyspark_code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

df = spark.table("sales.product_sales")

window_spec = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy(F.col("total_sales").desc())

result = (
    df
    .withColumn("rank", F.row_number().over(window_spec))
    .filter(F.col("rank") <= 3)
    .select("category", "product_name", "total_sales", "rank")
    .orderBy("category", "rank")
)

result.show()

description: Pivot monthly sales data to show months as columns for each salesperson
pyspark_code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

df = spark.table("sales.monthly_sales")

result = (
    df
    .withColumn("month", F.date_format("sale_date", "yyyy-MM"))
    .groupBy("salesperson_id", "salesperson_name")
    .pivot("month")

description: Deduplicate customer records keeping the most recent entry based on updated_at timestamp
pyspark_code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

df = spark.table("crm.customers_raw")

window_spec = Window.partitionBy("customer_email").orderBy(F.col("updated_at").desc())

result = (
    df
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(window_spec))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")

description: Calculate year-over-year revenue growth rate per product line
pyspark_code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

df = spark.table("finance.annual_revenue")

window_spec = Window.partitionBy("product_line").orderBy("fiscal_year")

result = (
    df
    .withColumn("prev_year_revenue", F.lag("revenue").over(window_spec))
    .withColumn(
        "yoy_growth_pct",
        F.when(
            F.col("prev_year_revenue").isNotNull() & (F.col("prev_year_revenue") != 0),
            ((F.col("revenue") - F.col("prev_year_revenue")) / F.col("prev_year_revenue") * 100)
        ).otherwise(None)
    )
    .orderBy("product_line", "fiscal_year")
)

result.show()

description: Join three tables to create an order summary with customer info and product details
pyspark_code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

customers = spark.table("crm.customers")
orders = spark.table("sales.orders")
products = spark.table("catalog.products")

result = (
    orders
    .join(customers, "customer_id", "inner")
    .join(products, "product_id", "inner")
    .select(
        orders["order_id"],
        orders["order_date"],
        customers["customer_name"],
        customers["region"],
        products["product_name"],
        products["category"],
        orders["quantity"],
        orders["unit_price"],
        (F.col("quantity") * F.col("unit_price")).alias("total_amount")
    )
    .orderBy("order_date")
)

result.show()

description: Find all employees whose salary is above the department average
pyspark_code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

df = spark.table("hr.employees")

window_spec = Window.partitionBy("department_id")

result = (
    df
    .withColumn("dept_avg_salary", F.avg("salary").over(window_spec))
    .filter(F.col("salary") > F.col("dept_avg_salary"))
    .select("employee_id", "employee_name", "department_id", "salary", "dept_avg_salary")
    .orderBy("department_id", F.col("salary").desc())
)

result.show()

description: Create a report showing the count of active vs inactive users per signup month
pyspark_code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

df = spark.table("app.users")

result = (
    df
    .withColumn("signup_month", F.date_format("signup_date", "yyyy-MM"))
    .groupBy("signup_month")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("is_active") == True, 1)).alias("active_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("is_active") == False, 1)).alias("inactive_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("total_count")
    )
    .withColumn("active_pct", F.round(F.col("active_count") / F.col("total_count") * 100, 2))
    .orderBy("signup_month")
)

result.show()

description: Left join inventory with shipments and flag products with low stock (below reorder point)
pyspark_code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

inventory = spark.table("warehouse.inventory")
shipments = spark.table("warehouse.shipments")

pending_shipments = (
    shipments
    .filter(F.col("status") == "pending")
    .groupBy("product_id")
    .agg(F.sum("quantity").alias("pending_qty"))
)

result = (
    inventory
    .join(pending_shipments, "product_id", "left")
    .fillna(0, subset=["pending_qty"])
    .withColumn("effective_stock", F.col("current_stock") - F.col("pending_qty"))
    .withColumn(
        "low_stock_flag",
        F.when(F.col("effective_stock") < F.col("reorder_point"), True).otherwise(False)
    )
    .orderBy("effective_stock")
)

result.show()

description: Calculate customer lifetime value (total spend) and segment customers into tiers
pyspark_code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

customers = spark.table("crm.customers")
orders = spark.table("sales.orders")

clv = (
    orders
    .groupBy("customer_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum("order_total").alias("lifetime_value"),
        F.count("order_id").alias("total_orders"),
        F.min("order_date").alias("first_order"),
        F.max("order_date").alias("last_order")
    )
)

result = (
    customers
    .join(clv, "customer_id", "left")
    .fillna(0, subset=["lifetime_value", "total_orders"])
    .withColumn(
        "tier",
        F.when(F.col("lifetime_value") >= 10000, "platinum")
        .when(F.col("lifetime_value") >= 5000, "gold")
        .when(F.col("lifetime_value") >= 1000, "silver")
        .otherwise("bronze")
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("lifetime_value").desc())
)

result.show()

description: Generate a daily revenue report with percentage contribution per payment method
pyspark_code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

df = spark.table("finance.payments")

daily_totals = (
    df
    .groupBy("payment_date", "payment_method")
    .agg(F.sum("amount").alias("method_total"))
)

window_spec = Window.partitionBy("payment_date")

result = (
    daily_totals
    .withColumn("daily_total", F.sum("method_total").over(window_spec))
    .withColumn(
        "contribution_pct",
        F.round(F.col("method_total") / F.col("daily_total") * 100, 2)
    )
    .orderBy("payment_date", F.col("contribution_pct").desc())
)

result.show()
